title: Finitely Related Clones: Action Algebras and Applications to Free Algebras
summary: For finite-domain constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs), the polymorphism clone provides an algebraic framework for studying the associated constraint language. A central question in clone theory is whether a clone is finitely related, that is, whether it is determined by the operations preserving a finite set of relations. Here, we study this question through the action algebra of a clone on its own $n$-ary part.
